gaps.definition: Null coordinate counts are computed only on stored rows. Absent combinations are scalar differences. No dense user-day-timeslot tensor is allocated and no missing row is inserted. absent_slots_within_observed_user_days uses the global set of observed timeslot values for every user-day that has at least one row. The cartesian figure uses the observed sets of uid, day, and timeslot values.

rules.impossible_jump: After the last accepted point, reject the candidate when delta_t<=0 and separation>1 m, or when delta_t>0 and speed>1000 km/h.
rules.duplicate_timestamp: Reject the candidate when delta_t<=0 and separation<=1 m.
rules.null_island: Reject latitude==0 and longitude==0 before the jump test.
rules.bad_coordinate: Reject latitude outside [-90, 90] or longitude outside [-180, 180].
rules.grids: Equirectangular bins at 250, 500, and 1000 m. grid_y = floor(latitude * 111132.92 / meters). grid_x = floor(longitude * 111132.92 * cos(latitude) / meters). These bins are not YJMob indices and are not a projected CRS.

noisecapture.indicator_policy: points.noise_level, tracks.noise_level, areas.laeq, areas.la50, and areas.lden are accumulated separately. leq_profile arrays are stored as JSON text and are not reduced to a mean. The energy mean is 10*log10(mean(10^(L/10))). The arithmetic mean is the mean of the decibel numbers. Track duration-weighted energy mean uses time_length as the weight and is separate from the unweighted energy mean.
